picks.catalyst: In-session own news: GE Aerospace signed $12.9B of deals at the China International Import Expo (Benzinga 09:31 ET; Flightglobal: China Eastern GEnx-1B orders for 787s and Xiamen Leap-1A orders for A320s, disclosed 5 November in Shanghai; the $12.9B total is the Benzinga headline, not confirmed from a second source). Small gap (open 317.79, +1.0% vs 314.73) and then the day's industrial leader: 324.7 at 10:19, +2.2% from its open and +3.2% on the day vs SPY +1.0% / XLI +0.7% / CAT -1.8% from its open (HON +2.9% from its open, RTX +1.4%). Industrials theme neutral (PERIPH_UP heat flag), not turning, so a call is allowed; reported 10-21, next report late January. Friday weekly expiry = same-day. catalyst_intraday buys a ~0.2-delta nearest-expiry call now and trails; NFP day, no event filter on the catalyst variants. Risks: part of the move is the day-after bounce (GE -4.5% open to close on 11-05), China order headlines fade, and the index can turn after 11:00 as it did yesterday.
picks.catalyst_zh: GE 航空今早在上海进博会签了 129 亿美元的订单（东航买 787 的 GEnx 发动机、厦航买 A320 的 Leap，彭博/Benzinga 09:31 标题），开盘只高开 1%，之后一路走到 +3.2%，是今天工业股里的领头羊（工业 ETF 只 +0.7%，卡特彼勒比开盘还低）。消息是今天的、缺口小、股价顺着走，工业主题不在转向名单上，所以买看涨。风险：昨天 GE 跌了 4.5%，今天一部分是反弹；中国订单的标题常常当天就消化完。

Sniper: catalyst_open bought LLY 11-06 1430C at 0.91 (09:32, 1 real contract, 10-delta) -> 0.07 at 10:02 (LLY would need +5%); catalyst_open_hero shadow 1390C 2.36 -> peak 3.87 at the 1377 high -> 2.08. Pick: GE call (own news, leader, tape agrees, neutral theme). Put mirror: SMH is below its open at 10:17, earlier than any day this week, but chips are a turning theme and CLAUDE.md gives the mirror only with the 11:00 confirmation; see conditional_1121.
conditional_1121: For 11:21: if SMH is still below its 473.41 open and has not reclaimed half of the 09:30-10:17 drop (above ~469), the weakest mega-cap chip still within 3% of its own open is the put candidate: MU (708.00 open, 698.6 at 10:17, -1.3%; same-day expiry) or TSM (379.90 open, 374.3, -1.5%; Friday expiry); AVGO (-3.6% from its open) is past the line unless it bounces back inside it. No sector negative broke this morning; the case is the failed bounce itself (BOUNCE.md). If SMH is back above its open, the bounce held and nothing is done on the put side. NFP day: the catalyst variants have no event filter.

opportunities.why: Mirror candidate for 11:21: SMH -1.8% from its open at 10:17 after a +5.7% open; MU -1.3% from its 708 open (+6.4% day, -17.5% yesterday). Turning theme, so the mirror waits for the 11:00 confirmation.
